title: VIETNAM EN IMMERSION
subtitle: Meet • Share • Discover
excerpt: Discover Vietnam on a deeper level: meet locals, share meaningful moments, and experience authentic culture.

body.heading: HOMESTAY IN HOANG SU PHI
body.text: This journey takes you through breathtaking valleys and terraced rice fields. You will stay with local families, share meals, work together, and listen to everyday life stories — a rare experience that typical tours simply cannot offer.

body.heading: Host Portrait
body.text: Your host is a local resident who has been deeply connected to this land since childhood. They warmly welcome visitors with genuine hospitality, helping you understand highland traditions, lifestyle, and culture.

body.heading: Accommodation
body.text: Simple yet cozy lodging with open views of terraced rice fields and lush nature. Fully equipped for a comfortable stay, while preserving the true spirit of living like a local.

title: HOMESTAY EXPERIENCES
subtitle: Live Close to the Locals
excerpt: Stay with local families to discover a more authentic side of Vietnam — beyond the cities.

body.heading: Why Choose This Stay?
body.text: This experience allows you to truly connect with local life: family meals, village stories, and hidden paths untouched by mass tourism.

body.heading: Our Commitment
body.text: We prioritize sustainable tourism: respecting local communities, reducing plastic waste, and creating fair economic opportunities.

title: HOANG SU PHI
subtitle: In the Heart of Terraced Rice Fields
excerpt: Golden harvest season, layered rice terraces — one of the most stunning landscapes in Northern Vietnam.

body.heading: Highlights
body.text: Light trekking, cloud hunting, local cuisine experiences, and captivating stories of highland culture.
